name: Resonite Crystal
summary: In Boulderslide Cavern, kobolds dig frantically for Resonite Crystal. Their work has drawn Mor'rogal's concern at Sun Rock Retreat.

sections.title: Ancient Resonance
sections.body: Kobolds dig frantically for Resonite Crystal deep in Boulderslide Ravine. Their sudden focus alarms the shamans at Sun Rock Retreat. Mor'rogal examines the stones and hears a faint magical hum. He recognizes traces of Earthen magic. The signs point to an ancient layer shaped by the Titans.

sections.title: Tapping the Earth
sections.body: Kobold diggers have reached deep enough to disturb the ancient Earthen. The Titans shaped the Earthen to carve and mold the world's foundations. Their magic still clings to the surrounding rock. Horde agents gather Resonite Crystal to learn what drives the kobolds and turn the enchanted stone's power against whatever slumbers below.

faq.answer: Resonite Crystals lie inside Boulderslide Cavern, deep within Boulderslide Ravine in the southeastern Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why are the kobolds mining Resonite Crystals?
faq.answer: The kobolds mine the rare crystals frantically, but Mor'rogal does not know why. He asks for samples and an investigation of the cave's depths to learn what they are doing.

faq.q: What kind of power is in a Resonite Crystal?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal suspects the crystals connect to something troubling beneath the mountains. He recognizes their magical nature after samples and news from the cavern reach him.
Mor'rogal, a tauren at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains, studies the crystals. He seeks to understand the sudden rise in kobold activity and find a way to counter the evil uncovered.

faq.q: What are the Earthen mentioned in connection to the crystal?
faq.answer: The Earthen were created by the Titans to shape the land. Mor'rogal investigates a possible connection between them and Resonite.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can sense the unsettling resonance in Resonite Crystals. It is dormant, primordial earth magic left by Titan creations buried beneath the mountains.
As a miner, you find Resonite in intensely concentrated formations unlike ordinary copper or tin veins. Reaching it means delving past aggressive kobolds into the deepest subterranean strata.
